title: What Spoke Our Ancient Sovereign (Kumno U Ong U Syiem Jong Ngi)
khasi_title: Kumno U Ong U Syiem Jong Ngi
cultural_context: Published historical Khasi song from authentic literature, documenting ancestral culture, moral philosophy, and oral tradition.
lyrics_khasi:
Kumno u ong u Syiem jong ngi hyndai,
Haba u ieng ha ka Durbar bakhraw?
'Kamai ia ka hok, kyntait ia ka sang,
Iada ia ka Ri haduh ban da iap!'

Ki waitlam ki la phyrnai ha ka kti,
Ki stieh ki la pynkhih ia ka madan;
Ki rangbah shlur ki la kular da ka snam,
Ban pynneh ia ka laitluid jong ka jaitbynriew.
lyrics_english:
What spoke our sovereign ruler of old,
As he addressed the great assembly of state?
'Earn your life in righteousness, banish moral taboo,
And defend the motherland unto your dying breath!'

The broadswords flashed bright in their hands,
The bronze shields rattled across the field;
The brave warriors covenanted in blood,
To preserve forever the freedom of our people.
